limitations: Only four-cycle bouquets with a single shared vertex; ordinary integral homotopy, no equivariant or arbitrary-cactus result. Novelty is claimed for k>=4; possible unindexed equivalent work.
scientific_integrity: The all-parameter proof is symbolic. Finite executable checks are corroboration only. Originality comparisons distinguish vertex gluing from edge/corner square sequences.
title: All-threshold sphere wedges for bouquets of quadrilaterals
